where in git are these artifacts
Today
Show thinking

They aren't in git by default.

When you ask me to make a web artifact (page / app / game), here's where it actually lives:

1. Source: /mnt/data/src/ - React/TypeScript files while I'm building
2. Built preview: The container://... link I give you - that's a single HTML file built from that source, served from the sandbox
3. No git repo is created automatically in this environment. If you run git status right now there's nothing to find - that's why you can't see them in git.

In this conversation we haven't created any artifacts yet, so /mnt/data is empty.

If you want them in git:

  • I can git init in /mnt/data, add the files, and commit them for you
  • Or I can export the built HTML file so you can add it to your own repo locally
